0022600205.text: Detroit (6-3, first in the Central and third in the East, currently on a two-game losing streak) hosts Washington (4-6, ninth in the East and third in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, on a three-game losing streak). Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Anthony Davis is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 117-95 win in Washington on March 19.
